facts.claim: Sportskeeda (2026-07-27) says a beginner session starts with a short in-farm tutorial and that all gameplay stays on the player's own farm.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: After collecting eggs, players step on a Deposit Eggs pad to send them to the Egg Shop. A brown board on the right side of the farm shows processing progress before cash is ready.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Processed eggs become cash that is picked up by walking onto a Collect Cash pad.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Chickens are bought by stepping on Buy 1, Buy 5, Buy 25, or Buy 100 pads, which deduct cash and place chickens on the farm.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Up to three chickens can be merged at the Merge pad into one higher-quality chicken.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: TechWiser's beginner guide likewise says you buy chickens, sell eggs for money, then purchase more chickens and merge them into higher-tier variants that drop more eggs.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: TechWiser says every chicken has a chance to lay a Lucky Block, each Lucky Block can reward one of three different chickens, and opening it costs a small fee. It recommends beginners skip Lucky Blocks early and save cash.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Eurogamer describes Lucky Blocks as a way to hatch new chickens, then merge them into rarer birds that boost earnings while filling an index.

first_10_minutes: Join Chicken Farm by Skandi Studios at place 137233438285284 (universe 10209534490). The live display name is Chicken Farm 🐣.
Complete the short on-farm tutorial. All early play happens on your own farm, not an open overworld.
Walk over eggs rolling out of the yellow chicken building. Collection is proximity-based.
Step on Deposit Eggs, watch the brown processing board, then step on Collect Cash.
Spend the first cash on Buy 1 or Buy 5. Larger Buy 25 / Buy 100 pads wait until the wallet can refill the farm after a spend.
As soon as you have matching birds, use the Merge pad (up to 3 chickens) to make a higher-quality chicken.
After the tutorial, open the ABX / Codes control on the top HUD and redeem currently valid strings exactly, including punctuation such as freecasssh!.
Optional: join Skandi Studios (group 34492682) for the advertised in-game group reward.
Leave the farm running. Official copy says chickens keep laying while you are away.
Skip paid Lucky Blocks and the 499 Robux Double Eggs pass until the basic collect → deposit → cash loop is automatic.
If you want a cheap quality-of-life pass later, the official catalog prices Auto Collect Money at 29 Robux and Auto Collect Eggs at 79 Robux. Neither is required.
Bookmark Discord https://discord.com/invite/chickfarm for new codes; do not trust a screenshot of yesterday's blog table.
core_loop: Buy chickens on the Buy 1 / 5 / 25 / 100 pads.
Chickens lay eggs that roll onto the farm floor, including while you are offline.
Walk over eggs to collect them.
Deposit eggs at the Egg Shop pad and wait for processing on the brown board.
Collect cash from the Collect Cash pad.
Reinvest cash into more chickens or higher buy tiers.
Merge up to three chickens into a rarer bird that lays more valuable eggs.
Lucky Blocks are an optional random chicken source; they can cost a fee to open.
Rebirth when the cash requirement is met to raise the permanent cash multiplier and unlock more Buy tiers.
At Rebirth 3, Gem Upgrades become available (Update 7).
Optional paid shortcuts: Auto Collect Money (29 Robux), Auto Collect Eggs (79 Robux), Double Eggs (499 Robux).
progression_path: Minutes 0–10: tutorial, first Buy 1/5 flock, first merges, first cash-out.
Early farm: keep depositing so cash is never sitting as unprocessed eggs.
Merge toward rarer chickens instead of only stacking more of the cheapest bird.
Unlock larger buy pads (25 / 100) when a purchase will not empty the farm.
Treat Lucky Blocks as extras after production is stable; TechWiser advises beginners to skip them.
First rebirth: Sportskeeda listed 1,000,000 cash / x3; AllThings.How listed 5 million / x2. Confirm the live red button, then reset.
Expect cash, eggs, chickens, and Processing Level to wipe unless you pay Robux Skip.
Each successful rebirth should add buy tiers (AllThings.How: +2 per rebirth; Update 7 also added 4 new tiers globally).
Rebirth 3: Gem Upgrades unlock. Do not invent gem effect numbers.
Update 7 also added two extra rebirths and two extra Lucky Block types; later costs belong on the in-game rebirth screen.
Late game: keep checking the live rebirth button rather than any blog table. Sportskeeda goes to 11 rows; AllThings.How caps at 8 and marks several TBC.
Codes and Discord drops are boosts, not a substitute for the merge / rebirth loop.
common_mistakes: Typing codes with the wrong case, extra spaces, or after they expire / hit a redeem cap.
Trying to redeem codes before finishing the tutorial.
Treating one blog's 'active codes' list as official. Destructoid, PCGamesN, GameRant, and Eurogamer already disagree on 19 August 2026.
Spending starter cash on Lucky Blocks instead of production chickens.
Rebirthing with no buy-back cash and no Skip, then sitting on an empty farm.
Never rebirthing, which leaves the cash multiplier flat.
Confusing this game with Chicken Farm Tycoon (place 10868496812) or unrelated chicken-farm blogs.
Publishing Sportskeeda or AllThings.How rebirth numbers as current official costs after Update 7.
Assuming there is an official wiki or Trello.
Presenting live CCU / visits / likes as if they never change.
Inventing a complete chicken-tier tree or Gem Upgrade list.
Calling 50MVisits a specific Lucky Block rarity when outlets already conflict (Basic vs Hacker vs generic).
faq: Who made Chicken Farm? Verified Roblox group Skandi Studios (id 34492682), owned by SamirDevs.
What are the IDs? Place 137233438285284, universe 10209534490.
Do chickens produce offline? Yes. Official description says they keep laying while you are away.
How do I get rarer chickens? Merge up to three at the Merge pad. Lucky Blocks can also grant new chickens.
How do I turn eggs into cash? Collect by walking, Deposit Eggs, wait for processing, Collect Cash.
How do I redeem codes? ABX / Codes on the top HUD, type exactly, Redeem. Case-sensitive.
Which codes work today? Only an in-game or Discord check is trustworthy. Official description does not print a list.
When do Gem Upgrades unlock? Official Update 7: Rebirth 3.
What does rebirth reset? Cash, eggs, chickens, and Processing Level, unless you buy Skip.
What gamepasses exist? Auto Collect Money 29 Robux, Auto Collect Eggs 79 Robux, Double Eggs 499 Robux (catalog check 2026-08-20).
Is there an official wiki? Secondary outlets say no; use Discord chickfarm and the Skandi group.
Are there badges? The Roblox badges API returned none.
When did it launch? Games API created timestamp 2026-05-23.

uncertainties: No in-game redemption of any Chicken Farm code was performed. Destructoid, PCGamesN, GameRant, Eurogamer, Roblox Den, and KodeGG-style trackers disagree on the 2026-08-19 active set and on Lucky Block names.
Exact current chicken names, merge recipes, egg values, and chicken-type count are unpublished. Sportskeeda's 'over 36 types' is dated 2026-07-27 and predates Update 7's extra Buy Tiers.
Full rebirth cost/multiplier table after Update 7 is unverified. Sportskeeda (to Rebirth 11, R1 = 1M / x3) conflicts with AllThings.How (cap 8, R1 = 5M / x2, several TBC).
Gem Upgrade effects, costs, and the full upgrade list are not documented outside the official 'unlock at rebirth 3' line.
Lucky Block tiers, open fees, and drop tables are unclear (Basic / Hacker / generic Lucky Block naming already conflicts).
Processing Level mechanics beyond 'exists and is reset by rebirth' were not found.
Index rewards, if any, are not documented; Eurogamer only says players fill out an index.
ABX button placement is reported as top / top-left / toward the end of the top-left row / top-right.
Exact in-game rewards for joining Skandi Studios are not specified beyond the group description.
No official public wiki, Trello, or developer design doc was found.
The Aug 22 ADMIN ABUSE event listing can expire or move; do not hard-code it as evergreen.
YouTube comment rosters (Duck / Dirt / Bee / Dummy egg values) were not independently verified and must stay out of approved facts.
forbidden_claims: Do not treat FunFirst Tycoons' Chicken Farm Tycoon (place 10868496812) as this game.
Do not publish a canonical currently-working codes list without a fresh in-game or Discord check; secondary lists conflict.
Do not present live CCU, visits, likes, or favorites as evergreen facts.
Do not claim a complete chicken-tier list, merge tree, egg-value table, or Gem Upgrade list.
Do not treat Sportskeeda or AllThings.How rebirth costs as official after Update 7.
Do not claim there is an official Chicken Farm wiki or Trello.
Do not invent egg values, cash-per-chicken rates, or leaderboard rewards.
Do not copy long passages from Roblox or third-party guides into site copy.
Do not describe 50MVisits as a specific Lucky Block rarity without noting the naming conflict.
